gh_024b04048e3f69628f6e111a.title: [远程] 加密卡公司诚聘#财务专家顾问 薪水$2100 - $3500USD
gh_024b04048e3f69628f6e111a.description:
岗位职责：
1️⃣ 为公司虚拟币业务提供整体财务架构设计与优化建议；
2️⃣ 参与虚拟币支付的财务流程设计；
3️⃣ 审核现有财务流程设计，识别潜在风险点（如资金错配、对账异常、链上风险等）；
4️⃣ 协助搭建虚拟币资金流与账务体系，确保“链上资金 + 内部账务”一致；
5️⃣ 指导产品与技术团队，将财务逻辑嵌入系统（而非人工处理）；
6️⃣ 提供虚拟币支付及清算相关最佳实践（参考交易所 / Crypto Payment / Crypto Card行业）；
7️⃣ 协助设计对账机制（链上 + 系统 + 第三方）；
8️⃣ 在关键节点提供决策建议（如通道选择、资金路径设计、费用模型等）。

🌵  岗位要求：
1️⃣ 有真实虚拟币支付或交易所财务经验（必须项）；
2️⃣ 具备以下任一背景优先：
  ◦ 加密货币交易所（如清结算 / 财务 / 资金岗位）
  ◦ 虚拟币支付公司
3️⃣ 熟悉主流链路（如TRC20、ERC20）及其资金流转逻辑；
4️⃣ 有虚拟币业务财务流程设计经验；
5️⃣ 熟悉对账机制（链上对账 / 内部账 / 通道对账）；
6️⃣ 能独立发现问题并给出结构化解决方案；
7️⃣ 有较强风控意识，理解常见资金风险模型。
💡 加分项：
1️⃣ 有虚拟币交易所、虚拟币各类支付产品落地经验；
2️⃣ 熟悉Visa / Master通道结算逻辑；
3️⃣ 有多币种资金池管理经验；
4️⃣ 有跨境支付或合规经验；
5️⃣ 有审计或风控背景。

Email: liwei3it@gmail.com   （猎头及第三方招聘平台请勿联系，谢谢配合）
Telegram: @xxbteo

gh_029af2b880506194635d23b8.title: [Cidade do México, México] Senior Software Engineer, Chrome Test Infrastructure na Google
gh_029af2b880506194635d23b8.description:
## Descrição da vaga: Esta é uma vaga de um parceiro da plataforma Coodesh, ao candidatar-se você terá acesso as informações completas sobre a empresa e benefícios. Fique atento ao redirecionamento que vai te levar para uma url [https://coodesh.com](https://coodesh.com/jobs/senior-software-engineer-chrome-test-infrastructure-181722226?utm_source=github&utm_medium=qa-brasil-vagas&modal=open) para realizar a candidatura. 👋 In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Only applications of candidates with Mexican citizenship will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 7 of the Federal Labor Law.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms and software development in one or more programming languages.
  • Experience with distributed systems and architecture, and systems integration.
  • Experience in cloud/full-stack web development (e.g., Python, JavaScript).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with ML algorithms and AI application development.
  • 4 years of experience deploying Continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Quality (CQ) systems.
  • Experience with C++ development.

About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will help ensure Chrome remains the safest, fastest and most reliable browser.

Our team is in charge of building and maintaining the processes and code that helps build the most beloved browser in the world.


As part of our team you will not only be building infrastructure you will be developing a product that helps thousands of experienced engineers achieve their goals.To build the next generation of infrastructure support you will have to develop innovative algorithms for outlier detection and test success modeling. You will integrate LLMs into the development flow for faster regression detection. You will understand our clients needs to best serve them.

Chrome is dedicated to building a better, more open web. We’re focused on making a better browser (on both desktop and mobile) to help users take advantage of all the web has to offer in a safe and secure way.Chrome is available across all major platforms — iOS, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux and Chrome OS. We also built Chrome as an open source project so the entire web ecosystem could benefit from the latest innovations in speed, simplicity and security.

Responsibilities

  • Build the next generation of test infrastructure.
  • Integrate LLMs with our detection systems for more accurate pinpointing of issues.
  • Develop novel algorithms for optimizing build and test run times.
  • Work with Chrome developers to identify pain points in the Chrome release process.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form. ## Google: A problem isn't truly solved until it's solved for all. Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Bring everything that makes you unique. Together, we can build for everyone. ## Local: Mexico City, México ## Como se candidatar: Candidatar-se exclusivamente através da plataforma Coodesh no link a seguir: [Senior Software Engineer, Chrome Test Infrastructure na Google](https://coodesh.com/jobs/senior-software-engineer-chrome-test-infrastructure-181722226?utm_source=github&utm_medium=qa-brasil-vagas&modal=open) Após candidatar-se via plataforma Coodesh e validar o seu login, você poderá acompanhar e receber todas as interações do processo por lá. Utilize a opção **Pedir Feedback** entre uma etapa e outra na vaga que se candidatou. Isso fará com que a pessoa **Recruiter** responsável pelo processo na empresa receba a notificação. ## Labels #### Alocação Alocado #### Categoria Testes/Q.A

*Desenvolvedor IONIC Sr (Remoto)*

Desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis com Ionic e Capacitor (Mandatório) - Mínimo 5 anos de experiência
Escrita de testes unitários e instrumentados; - Mínimo 4 anos de experiência
Conhecimento em Angular 2+ e Typescript; (Mandatório) - Mínimo 5 anos de experiência
Conhecimento em estilos e/ou padrões arquiteturais para frontend; Mínimo 4 anos de experiência
Conhecimento em padrões de projeto (design patterns) do GoF. Mínimo 4 anos de experiência
Desejável:
Experiência com React e/ou React Native; 

Experiência com projetos modularizados; 

Compreensão de requisitos funcionais escritos no formato Gherkin. 

Jasmine não será necessariamente o framework de testes utilizado (costumamos usar Jest, inclusive, e não Jasmine). 

MVC, MVVM etc não são padrões de projeto (design patterns), são padrões arquiteturais. Habilidade de escrita técnica é um requisito muito abstrato.
Regime de Contratação: PJ (Full *Time das 09 às 18h00) - Não poderá conciliar com outros trabalhos.*

*Projeto de 3 meses com chances de prorrogação.*

Caso tenha interesse ou indicações favor encaminhar cv com pretensão salarial para edgar@bluesix.com.br 

*OBS: Só iremos avaliar currículos que estejam mencionando em quais empresas utilizou as ferramentas e tecnologias solicitadas no descritivo da vaga.*

gh_027f1e45021950bbac75cf80.title: 【Eatgether】徵後端資料庫工程師 Backend Developer
gh_027f1e45021950bbac75cf80.description:
《食我網路股份有限公司》致力於透過網路科技打造創新應用服務，「創造更美好的用餐與社交體驗」。分別於2014年與2016年完成種子與天使輪投資，也剛在2019年第三季完成2000萬台幣PreA輪募資。公司主要的產品為台灣最大的聚會交友 APP《Eatgether》，上線兩年多以來已經創造超過20萬次的聚會以及60萬個用戶。在創造足夠多的用戶互動後，也致力於創造更有效率的數據行銷機制，導引更多的客戶至合作商家消費。

食我目前是個相當精實的小型團隊，是個平均年齡約30歲，是個同時具備活力與技能經驗的團隊。動靜分明是我們的團隊文化，彈性自律是我們的工作風格，在這裡沒有太多的規範，上下班不打卡，也可自行安排工作時間，高度的自律搭配目標導向的管理模式，成就了一個快而精實的新創團隊。目前整個團隊都聚焦在開發 Eatgether，朝著打造一個來自台灣的國際化餐飲社交平台而努力。我們認為新創公司的人才就是一切，每個加入的人都會改變這個團隊與產品，非常期待有你的加入！

公司地址：台北市中正區忠孝西路一段50號22f-9 (快搬家了)
公司官網：https://eatgether.com/

請參考104公司介紹頁面：https://www.104.com.tw/company/1a2x6bis2k

**【工作任務】**
・網站與APP資料庫架構及API開發管理
・AWS+GCP伺服器穩定度優化與流量費用管理
・協助討論與開發各種平台新功能
・協助行銷與客服團隊整理相關後台數據資料

**【必備條件】**
・koa2
・node.js
・laravel
・postgresql
・mongodb

加分技能
・vue.js
・AWS
・GCP

**薪資待遇**
・依能力與經驗給薪，每半年調薪
・周休二日、見紅就放、可彈性工時
・對外課程或論壇可申請公假與學費補助
・每月團隊聚餐與慶生會
・工作滿一年後可申請以優惠選擇權方式入股

履歷請寄至：jobs@eatme.tw
